# Security policy

## Reporting a problem

Please **don't open a public issue** for security problems. Report them privately through
[GitHub's private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/js-surya/q2-eq-studio-ios/security/advisories/new)
for this repository. Include the app's version, your device and iOS version, and steps to reproduce.

You'll get a reply within a week. Once a fix ships, you'll be credited in the release notes
unless you'd rather not be.

## Scope

- **In scope:** the app, how it keeps its sign-in (Keychain) and talks to EQ Studio on the Q2.
- **Out of scope:** EQ Studio and Q2 Pod on the Q2. Please report those to
  [EQ Studio](https://github.com/DiamondBond/q2-eq-studio) or [Q2 Pod](https://github.com/DiamondBond/q2-pod).

## Supported versions

Only the latest release gets security fixes.
